pages.title: Abras' Open Conjure
pages.text: $(bold)Purpose:$() Summon an unbound $(#ad03fc)Afrit$()$(br2)$(bold)Abras' Open Conjure$() is a simplified version of $(#ad03fc)Abras' Conjure$(), allowing to summon $(#ad03fc)Afrit$() without red chalk. Due to the much reduced power of the pentacle, it cannot be used to control $(#ad03fc)Afrit$(), and it $()

pages.title: Abras' Open Conjure
pages.text: thus can only be used to fight and kill $(#ad03fc)Afrit$().$(br)
